transforms.code:
import system

	data = []

	if value is None:
		return data

	# Convert Named Query dataset to Python data
	pydata = system.dataset.toPyDataSet(value)

	for row in pydata:
		try:
			# Extract and format the hour bucket (full date + time)
			hour_bucket = row['hour_bucket']
			formatted_datetime = system.date.format(hour_bucket, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")

			# Actual sheets per hour
			sheets = row['total_sheets']

			# Target value (you can change this threshold)
			target = 150

			# Determine bar color based on whether production met/exceeded target
			if sheets >= target:
				color = "#61BEDA"  # blue
			else:
				color = "#FF8C00"  # orange

			# Append row to chart dataset
			data.append({
				"hour": formatted_datetime,  # X-axis
				"sheets": sheets,            # Y-axis (bar height)
				"target": target,            # optional reference line
				"color": color               # bar color
			})

		except Exception as e:
			system.util.getLogger("Composer2_XYChart").warn("Row transform error: %s" % str(e))

	return data
